description: This file implements Diffie-Hellman key generation and derivation functions, including Netflix-specific DH secret derivation, for cryptographic operations within a security module. It includes functions to generate key pairs and derive shared secrets, interfacing with external security libraries and a Vault object.

classes.name: Implementation::VaultNetflix
classes.description: A class managing cryptographic keys and operations specific to Netflix's security implementation.

methods.name: GenerateDiffieHellmanKeys
methods.description: Generates a Diffie-Hellman key pair (public and private keys) using specified parameters and stores them in the Vault.

methods.name: DiffieHellmanAuthenticatedDeriveSecret
methods.description: Derives shared secrets (encryption, HMAC, wrapping keys) using Netflix-specific DH derivation method.

methods.name: diffiehellman_generate
methods.description: Externally accessible function to generate DH key pair, interfacing with Vault.

methods.name: diffiehellman_derive
methods.description: Placeholder function for DH secret derivation, currently not implemented.

methods.name: netflix_security_derive_keys
methods.description: Externally accessible function to derive security keys using Netflix's DH derivation method.
